sources: Perilloux, Easton & Buss (2012). The misperception of sexual interest. Psychological Science 23(2). 96 men, 103 women (UT Austin), 3-minute speed-meetings with 5 partners; men overperceived women's sexual interest, women underperceived men's; overperception stronger for men with short-term orientation, men who rated themselves attractive, and the more attractive the man found the woman. Via APS press release.
